title: Chapter 213: The Amazing Combat Power Of The Zerg
content:
Chapter 213: The Amazing Combat Power Of The Zerg

The Zerg ground forces are deployed with Zerg Roaches and Hydralisks as the main force, fighting together and in the front line.

On both sides of the main force are Zerg Zerglings. The range of Zerg Roaches and Hydralisks can cover the front of Zerg Zerglings, so Zerg Zerglings do not need to fight before the enemy breaks through their long-range firepower coverage.

Below the Zerg Roaches and Hydralisks are stealth spiders that burrow into the ground. Their attack range is equivalent to that of Zerg Hydralisks. Their attack concealment is quite high and can give the enemy a surprise.

Behind the Zerg Roaches and Hydralisks are Zerg Destroyers arranged very loosely. They are attacking the Demon Army. Dense liquid fireball shells are constantly flying into the sky and flying towards the target position.

In order to reduce the defensive pressure of the Zerg Army phalanx, the Zerg Destroyers concentrated their firepower on the front position of the Demon Army when the Demon Army launched a charge, and attacked the Demon soldiers at the forefront.

Tens of thousands of liquid fireball shells were neatly arranged and fell among the charging demon soldiers. Except for those dog demons with one-star strength, the ordinary inferior demons and flame demons suffered heavy casualties.

There was a certain interval between the attacks of the Zerg destroyers, and many demon soldiers stepped on the hot corrosive mucus and continued to charge forward regardless of their comrades who were wailing under their feet!

"Boom boom...!"

The attack of the Zerg destroyers came again, interrupting the continuity of the demon army's charge and destroying a large number of the demon army's living forces.

The demon soldiers who were lucky enough to rush through the Zerg destroyers to block the fire attack were greeted by the Zerg Hydralisk's storm-like armor-piercing spikes. Whether it was the inferior demon, the flame demon, or the dog demon with stronger defense capabilities, they could not hold on under such an attack and disappeared one after another.

There were 200,000 Zerg Hydralisks, and their long-range output was very terrifying!

More and more demon troops rushed up. They were not afraid of casualties and charged fearlessly. After all, they broke through the double fire nets organized by the Zerg Destroyer and Zerg Hydralisk, and shortened the distance between them and the Zerg army phalanx.

Unfortunately, they were greeted by countless dense fire nets. Even the demon soldiers with high flame resistance could not withstand the corrosive flames sprayed by the Zerg cockroaches.

The Zerg organized a triple terrible fire net with more than 300,000 main combat troops, which made the demon army helpless for a while and could not rush through at all!

Countless demon soldiers fell on the way to charge!

The Naga tribe had seen the Zerg army fighting, but they had never seen the Zerg army fighting with such strong firepower. Such a firepower combination almost achieved the goal of destroying the enemy without loss, and eliminated a large number of enemies without casualties.

Observers from various forces basically saw the Zerg army fighting for the first time, and they were all shocked by the powerful combat power of the Zerg army.

"The coordination of these arms of the Zerg army is too perfect! It completely restrains the army of the demons!"

"Such a lineup not only restrains the demon army, but almost restrains most armies!"

"The siege-level arms in the Zerg army have excellent range and power. They are really battlefield weapons. Even if they are placed on the main battlefield of the camp war, they are extremely rare and powerful arms!"

"Each arm of the Zerg is not simple. They adapt to the battlefield environment through the evolution of their bodies. This is more extreme than the demons on the opposite side. They have all evolved into crazy fighting machines!"

"There are also flying arms that the Zerg has not taken action. The Zerg has sent such a lineup. It seems that this area is bound to win!"

"..."

These observers from various forces have seen through the Zerg's plot through a series of actions by the Zerg.

In this world, the entry and rise of each big clan is a legendary story. There are many such legendary stories circulating in the world, which let everyone have a certain understanding of the development history of the big clan.

When a big clan enters the world, it is inevitable to occupy a piece of land to gain a foothold.

The Zerg's intention to occupy this somewhat special area here is already obvious.

On the battlefield, the demon army's phalanx, the whole army moved forward, charging in the front line, and only the demon army facing the Zerg dragon group in the south continued to be on guard.

However, the mobility of the flying troops is very strong, and the ground troops' vigilance is useless. The black mass of Zerg dragons flew to the north of the demon army's phalanx.

The north of the demon army's phalanx has already moved with the front line of the charge, and the Zerg dragon group flew over and sprayed countless biological bombs!

The density of the fireballs fired by the flame demons in the demon army's phalanx below could not take off at all. As soon as they were launched, they were intercepted by the biological bombs of the Zerg dragons.

"Boom boom!"

The biological bombs sprayed by the Zerg dragons covered a large area of the demon army square below. The countless small biological bombs blown up by the big explosion flew around, flying towards the demon soldiers who were only injured but not killed, and continued to self-destruct!

Because of the special nature of the biological bombs sprayed by the Zerg dragons, after each big explosion of their attack, the dense small explosions would last for a long time.

The Zerg dragons bombed along the edge of the demon army square, and soon cleared a large area to the north of the demon army square. Hundreds of thousands of demon soldiers were wiped out, leaving nothing behind!

Wu Qing found that the flame demons of the demon army could not pose a threat to the Zerg dragons, so he let the Zerg dragon group no longer care about it. All 100,000 dragons pressed forward and bombed the demon army square formation.

The three-star flame demons that posed the greatest threat in the demon army, only more than 100 left, have been successfully controlled by the Zerg queens. They are also three-star in strength. The 20 Zerg queens spent a lot of time and energy to control these three-star flame demons.

More than 100 three-star flame demons gathered together, broke away from the demon army square formation, and fired a very powerful fireball at the demon army square formation under the Zerg dragon group.

Naga was not surprised by the powerful strength of the Zerg dragon group. She could predict the strength of the Zerg air force from the strength of the Zerg ground force.

She saw that the more than one hundred three-star flame demons had been standing still, and the Zerg army did not attack them. Now they suddenly rebelled, which made her look serious.

Naga seldom heard that demons could be controlled by others. The Zerg showed the outside world a terrible ability, which could easily arouse others' fear.

The conversion of believers in the evil god camp is generally aimed at ordinary people. After ordinary people are converted into believers of the evil god, they have obvious characteristics of fanatical belief, which cannot be disguised.

The stronger the strength, the more difficult it is to convert into evil god believers. This is also the reason why Wu Cong was used as a sacrifice instead of being converted into evil god believers.

The more determined the will is, the lower the success rate of conversion of evil god believers, and the greater the price paid by the evil god camp.

Now the Zerg has successfully controlled the most strategically valuable three-star flame demons of the demon clan on the battlefield. The value of this ability is immeasurable.

Observers from various forces have also discovered this situation.

"Silent beheading, control without a trace, these abilities of the Zerg are really terrifying!"

"The local camp will have another terrifying tribe! I don't know whether it is a blessing or a curse!"

"..."

The various abilities displayed by the Zerg made observers from all forces feel wary.

"Don't worry too much, our Goblin Chamber of Commerce has a cooperative relationship with the Zerg. We often deal with each other, and the Zerg is a very easy-to-get-along race!"

"The Zerg's entry into the world is definitely a great thing for our local camp!"

"Our Goblin Chamber of Commerce is preparing to recommend the Zerg to enter the main battlefield of the camp war. The stronger they are, the more beneficial it will be to our local camp!"

Gong Zhe saw everyone's reaction and stood up to speak for the Zerg.

His future is all tied to the Zerg, and the Goblins and the Zerg also have a vested interest. He doesn't want other forces to conflict with the Zerg, which is not good for him and the Goblins.

"Yes, it is very easy to do these things if the strong Zerg can come!"

"Yes!"

"..."

Gong Zhe, who represented the Goblin Chamber of Commerce, spoke for the Zerg, and everyone gave him face and stopped talking about this issue.

...

The demon army, which was attacked from both sides, had no way to deal with the Zerg dragon group in the rear. The fireballs fired by the flame demons were difficult to fly to the Zerg dragons. Even if they successfully bombed the Zerg dragons, the damage caused was very limited.

Facing the Zerg dragon group, the demon army could only passively take the beating.

Seeing the rapid loss of troops, the demon army, under the organization of the mysterious command system, rushed forward with all their might, trying to break through the triple firepower network of the Zerg ground forces.

As the front of the demon army disappeared under the attack of the Zerg, the proportion of flame demons and dog demons in the demon army in the rear phalanx continued to increase.

Especially the dog demons, who had a minimum strength of one star, had strong defense capabilities and resisted many frontal attacks.

This allowed some soldiers of the Demonic Army to finally break through the triple firepower net of the Zerg ground forces.

The fire demons' attacks finally reached the front line of the Zerg army. Their big fireballs flew up, but they didn't fly far before they were detonated by the attacks of the Zerg cockroaches and hydralisks. The limited number of fire demons could not launch an effective attack on the Zerg army.

"Stab, stab, stab..." Rows of armor-piercing spikes suddenly pierced out from the ground, piercing those dog demons with strong defensive capabilities!

The Zerg's stealth spiders finally took action, and they added another layer of firepower net to the Zerg army's defense line.

The four-layer firepower net of the Zerg ground forces, even if all the dog demons in the Demonic Army were gathered together, it would be difficult to break through such a defense line with a limited total number.

What's more, the Demonic Army, which had lost its high-level commanders, was simply unable to conduct such a level of command.
